core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_preference_michael_espresso: Michael prefers a sleek, modern stainless-steel finish; seeks an accessible espresso machine for a café-like experience without professional barista skills; values design aesthetics and simplicity in operation.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry_michael: Michael is in Seattle and concerned about shipping times due to rainy weather; wants to know if products ship from a local warehouse or out of state; is hosting a family gathering later this month and needs the product before then.
core_memory.user_warranty_inquiry_michael: Michael is concerned about warranty length and customer service quality; has had negative experiences with short warranties on other brands; specifically asks about warranty policy for higher-end models like the Aura Espresso Machine; values long-term reliability and support.
core_memory.user_temperature_inquiry_michael: Michael wants reliable hot coffee; previously had issues with cold drip machines; asks about temperature control in your models.
